[spoiler=The Files][quote=western_view;60007115][u]Lost At Sea[/u]
[b][i]Western View Paper[/i][/b]
Earlier today radio stations in North Western View, as well as ships in the Nestor ocean, picked up a mysterious message from a ship, the message was an SOS, but it also had a lot of static as well as what sounded like a fire alarm, and rushing water. Rescue teams were sent to the area, but they only found a single sheet of paper, with the faded words Leviathan. Operators soon realized that the SS Leviathan was the only ship unaccounted for. The SS Leviathan was a Leviathan class oil tanker, carrying 2 million tons of oil, headed for Eastornia-Kolionia. Many speculate that the ship was attacked, seeing that it's route led it close to a country in active war, though many say it is unlikely for SS Leviathan to be attacked, after all it was flying the Western View flag, and wasn't in an active war zone, and the Leviathan's coordinates suggest it was hit by a large storm, but since there have been no survivors found yet, we can only go by the single radio message the Leviathan sent.

Other facts about the SS Leviathan.
[list][*]The SS Leviathan is the largest Wessern ship ever built, at almost 1,000ft long.
[*]The SS Leviathan could carry up to 3 million tons of oil.
[*]The SS Leviathan entered service around 2 years ago, and it builders 4 years to build
[*]The SS Leviathan housed 40 crew memebers
[*]The SS Leviathan could go 17 knots in clear weather
[*]The SS Leviathan was considered to most advanced Wessern ship
[*]The SS Leviathan was built and launched in Wessernia, Western View's capital
[nation]Eastornia-Kolionia[/nation][/quote]
[quote=western_view;60014121][u]Search, Rescue, and Ivestigate[/u]
[b][i]Wetsern View Paper[/i][/b]
After a few weeks of searching, rescue teams finally found something. An inflatable life raft, with a tarp over it, inside they found two people. They were both rushed to the hospital, both had been exposed to the elements for way to long. Luckily they're currently in stable condition, mostly due to Western View's amazing doctors. The two people have been confirmed to be from the SS Leviathan, and have been fully identified. They are two of the ships bridge crew, Antonio Gasduiy (gasd-oo-E), and Joe Hangradais (Hangr-a-dias). Currently investigators from the WVTSB (Western View Transportation Safety Bureau) have been waiting for Antonia and Joe to be released from the hospital. While they wait, the WVTSB investigates the little clues they have. they have determined that the paper came from the ships files, and that the ship was not attacked by another country, because the SS Leviathan was fitted with sirens incase there was an external attack, but that doesn't rule out a bomb or a terrorist attack. The WVTSB has been searching for the wreck of the lost ship, with the militaries help, of course. Head council member Tony Messiaon has come yesterday with a speech about the lost ship, which has been getting a lot of attention, in his speech he stated, "This is a sad day for many, there are still 38 missing, I know, but we must keep moving forward, we must keep helping this country survive, and to thrive, even in the utmost of circumstances, but we are allowed to feel sad, or angry, we should feel sad and angry, in fact let us have a minute of silence for those missing right now." As the country of Western View grieves the missing, the search for any clues, survivors, or the wreck are in full swing, a quarter of the Wessernian navy and air force is involved in the search, and people are on the beaches searching for wreckage. After his speech Tony Messiaon has asked for an "Entire search, I do not think [nation]Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/nation] will help, but I will ask anyway, all countries that border the Nestor Ocean, please search your beaches for any pieces of metal, if you do find any, and are unable to identify it, please send it to us, and if you do identify it as the SS Leviathan's please send it to us immediately." There have been reports of oil in the ocean, so volunteers are coming to help save the dolphins, and other species from the growing crisis.

The WVTSB sated in a report, "The floating debris found has  been identified as part of the port section of the hull, near where the majority of the oil onboard was held. The debris also shows signs of an explosion, many pieces are burned, and are bent outwards. The WVIB (Western View Investigation Bureau) has been sent to examine the wreckage for explosive residue, for this could have been a bomb, but we cannot be certain until the test are finished." So far scientists have estimated 3,000 different SPECIES are now threatened by this oily hazard, and it's not only the wild life, it's the tourists too, thousands of tourists have had to go to the other side of Western View, just to swim without oil, but that may not be true for long, as the oil has been wrapping around the island, getting into rivers and lakes, and threatening the fresh water supply. [quote=western_view;60032211][u]The Discovery[/u]
[b][i]Western View Paper[/i][/b]
Today at 2:12 in the morning, Wessernian time, the crew of the SFS Trilobite found a long length on debris on the ocean floor. This debris trail ended up belonging to a ship wreck, 10 miles from where the SOS was sent, the SS Leviathan rest in many pieces on the ocean floor. The SFS Trilobite's crew celebrated at first, but quickly fell silent, because 38 people died on this ship, and many aquatic animals have almost died because of the oil. In the Western View Hospital, the two survivors of the sinking are said to be released tomorrow, and that means the WVTSB (Western View Transportation Safety Bureau) has the opportunity to interview the two crew members soon. The WVIB (Western View Investigation Bureau) has come out with the results of the bomb testing, and they have come to conclude that, yes, there was a bomb on board, but now they have to figure out what kind of bomb, and who placed it there.
[u]The Final Verdict[/u]
[i][b]Western View Paper[/b][/i]
After the WVIB (Western View Investigation Bureau) released a report on the results of the SS Leviathan debris piece, named piece 2, they came with the final verdict for the Wessernian Bridge collapse. It turns out it was a bomb, and they know who placed it, a man named Hatzur Zatsugi, the infamous leader of an Anti-Wessernian government group called the Guhui'Benardio (Juh-hoo-ben-ar-dE-O) and he was accompanied by 5 other men, Kiliwo Danf, Gerniu Jak, Ventru and Zero Dezervio, and Antio Ati. The WVIB has also requested that all bridges be closed until further notice, thus forcing many to airports and ship ports to get from one part of the island to another.
[u]Two in One Day[/u]
The Wessern 500, is a 500 mile race, and the most popular in Wessernia, with an average of 5,000,000 dollars made by selling tickets alone. Usually around 500,000 people watch the race live, and an estimated 1,000,000 people watch it at their houses. And as usual yesterday 500,000 people came to watch the race, unfortunately they'd also be a part of the worst racing crash in Wessern history. As the racers started the 4th lap of the Wessern 500, number 47, in first place, driven by council member, and race fanatic Jack Frantoil, suddenly flipped over, and flew into the stand, where five other council members were seated, Jack had instantly died, 3 council members in the stands were killed, and 2 were hospitalized. Another 15 people in the stands died, also the explosion sent debris on to the track causing 1 driver to die, and 4 to be hospitalized, thus bringing the total amount of dead to 20. The one driver that died was Kolionian, Hali Fretnioa, and international racing legend winning 5 races in the last two years. Later that day inside the capital building, during several important meetings, a bomb exploded on the fourth floor, causing the tall building to collapse. of the 400 or so government officials inside, 138 died, as well as 2 people outside, and 5 fire fighters. the disaster caused a complete shut down of down town Wessernia to be shut down for two hours. A total of 145 people died in and around the capital building. Tony Messiaon has been hospitalized, and the entirety of Western View is on lock down, and there was a minute of silence for all the lives lost that day. The WVIB (Western View Investigation Bureau) has already concluded that these were both bombs, and they were the work of Hatzur Zatsugi, leader of the Guhui'Benardio. Security cameras showed him and his associates at both scenes before the disaster happened, always stoping to place something somewhere before leaving.
